HGI_reference: 2005-06 survey weighted reference; HbA1c (%) minus frozen linear prediction from fasting glucose; 2D controls HGI+FPG and HbA1c/log-insulin residuals vs FPG; published equation sensitivity HbA1c=0.024*FPG(mg/dL)+3.1 (overlaps NHANES development, not independent)
CI: rescaled stratified PSU bootstrap with full design frame; conditional fixed maps and prediction models; refit WLS for partial R2; 95% marginal intervals
external: metadata inventory; explicit verified harmonised CSV only
survey_weight_notes: Cycle-specific fasting subsample WTSAF2YR (OGTT WTSOG2YR); complete-case item nonresponse not separately reweighted. Script118 weight audit preserved; pooled weight construction not independently audited.
